sequenceNote: Verified by reading each draft's actual Hebrew content in preview: the 4 CRC drafts (L'cha Dodi 1-4) turn out to already cover verses 1 (Shamor), 2 (Likrat), 5 (Hitoreri) and 9 (Boi) despite their generic numeric names -- draft 'L'cha Dodi 3' is textually Hitoreri, and draft 'L'cha Dodi 4' is textually Boi. Combined with the 5 named Shirei supplement drafts (Mikdash=3, Hitna'ari=4, Lo Tevoshi=6, V'hayu Limshisa=7, Yamin u'Smol=8), all 9 traditional verses (Shamor, Likrat, Mikdash, Hitnaari, Hitoreri, LoTevoshi, Vhayu, Yamin, Boi) are present with no gaps and no duplicates. No additional 'Likrat/Hitoreri/Boi' supplement drafts exist separately -- list_drafts query 'cha Dodi' returned exactly these 9 total. All 9 now share layout left, arrangement blocks, comfortable typography, latinLineBreaks paragraphs, and accent title לכה דודי.
